topic.title: Review Tasks
topic.shortdesc: A review task is a shared review space where task owners and reviewers work together on content feedback.

body.p: In , review tasks are used to collect feedback on content. A task owner shares content with reviewers, who open the task in a browser-based editor to read, comment, and suggest changes.
Review tasks support a focused review workflow. Instead of sending files by email, authors can share a task link and keep all comments, suggestions, and discussions in one place.
supports two types of review tasks: Project Review Tasks and Independent Review Tasks.

section.title: Project Review Tasks
section.p: A Project Review Task is created from content in a project. It is part of the project workflow. Accepted changes can be integrated back into the project content.

section.title: Independent Review Tasks
section.p: An Independent Review Task is not tied to a project. It can be created in the interface or from supported desktop tools. Any follow-up integration is handled outside the project workflow.

There is an Oxygen Content Fusion Connector add-on that can be installed to integrate Oxygen Content Fusion into Oxygen XML Editor or Oxygen XML Author desktop tools. This allows to create independent review tasks directly from those desktop tools and integrate proposed changes back into the original content source. For more information about this add-on, see the Oxygen Content Fusion Connector Add-on Documentation.

section.title: Task types and user roles
section.p: Project Review Tasks can be created only by Authors while Independent Review Tasks can be created by both Authors and Subject-Matter Experts.
Any user can participate in a review task as a Reviewer.

section.title: Roles in a review task
section.p: Within a review task, users participate through .

ul.li: Owner - Manages the task, shares access, and controls the review workflow.
Reviewer - Reviews the content, adds comments, suggests changes, and joins discussions.
